title: 真题演练 · if 条件句
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 if 条件句。

questions.q: If you ___ hard, you will succeed.
questions.analysis: 第一条件句:if 从句用一般现在时。

questions.q: If I ___ a bird, I would fly freely.
questions.analysis: 与现在事实相反的虚拟,be 用 were。

questions.q: If she ___ the truth, she would not have lied.
questions.analysis: 与过去相反,从句用过去完成时 had known。

questions.q: ___ you need help, just call me.
questions.analysis: Should 提头省略 if,表示"万一",这是正式用法。

questions.q: If you heat ice, it ___ into water.
questions.analysis: 零条件句表普遍真理,主句用一般现在时。

questions.q: 判断对错:If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.
questions.analysis: 应改为:If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.。if 条件从句中不用 will,用一般现在时表将来。
